acceptedWorkstreams.title: Add a rule-compliant WhatsApp sharing kit for study groups
acceptedWorkstreams.description: University study groups often coordinate in messaging groups, while the campaign plan currently focuses on social posts and a video. Add copy-ready WhatsApp messages for a group admin to share only where group rules allow, with a short opt-in invitation, a five-minute setup link placeholder and a reminder that the free plan is being described accurately. Include a no-spam rule, a source/approval checklist for each claim, and a tagged-link measurement plan that does not collect student personal data. This adds a distinct distribution channel without promising paid features.
